links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of RL-trained agentic RAG versus prompt-engineering and training-free RAG methods
links.effect: End-to-end RL agentic RAG consistently outperformed prompt-engineering and training-free RAG; average accuracy gain of 22.7% over the second-best model on ID and OOD benchmarks.
links.quote: Experiments show our end-to-end RL framework consistently outperforms prompt-engineering and training-free RAG methods.

unlisted_practices: End-to-end reinforcement learning training of agentic RAG with soft verifiable rewards co-optimizing retrieval and reasoning
Case-based retrieval from patient records and guideline-derived disease profiles for traceable diagnostic reasoning

screen.reason: Evaluates an agentic RAG diagnostic tool both on benchmarks and in a physician reader study comparing diagnostic accuracy with and without the AI assistant on 150 clinical cases.
